# eSIM.dog: full product and price catalogue

> Prepaid travel eSIMs with fixed data allowances, daily high-speed allowances, configurable unlimited plans and regional coverage.

Base price snapshot: 2026-11-14. Currency: USD. Each price is for the complete stated package or billing period. Tax may be added at checkout as shown on the product page.

## Products and help
- Country plans: fixed data, or a selectable number of days for unlimited plans. https://esim.dog/
- Regional plans: packages covering several countries. Coverage is listed with each group below. https://esim.dog/regions
- WorldPass: global data subscription. https://esim.dog/worldpass

WorldPass prices exclude the optional UK phone number, which is preselected on the product page. Turn off Add a phone number to buy WorldPass alone.

Plan|Initial base payment USD|Initial period|Monthly equivalent USD|Recurring base payment|Buy
---|---:|---|---|---|---
WorldPass monthly|30.00|1 month|30.00|USD 30.00 every month|https://esim.dog/worldpass?term=1
WorldPass 3-month introductory offer|45.00|3 months|15.00 during the first 3 months|USD 75.00 every 3 months after the first 3 months|https://esim.dog/worldpass?term=3
WorldPass annual|180.00|12 months|15.00|USD 180.00 every 12 months|https://esim.dog/worldpass?term=12

## Reading the catalogue
Find the destination in a directory below. For fixed packages, search COUNTRY: fixed SIZE. For daily or fully unlimited plans, search its destination name and daily allowance or continuous speed, or its single-word key, then read the matching price block, not just the directory entry. Copy names, units and keys exactly. If a search returns other countries or only the directory, find the country heading COUNTRY (CODE) and read that section.

Every price is the total USD charge for the stated package and duration. Unlimited price rows list the shop's price points as days=USD. Every integer duration from the first to the last listed day is available. First use an exact quote for the requested day if the plan has one; otherwise use a listed price point. Lines marked 'exact quotes' give additional exact totals for their stated days only and do not replace or split the price-point intervals. For a day between two adjacent points, use exactly the shop's calculation: total USD = round_to_2_decimals(lower_price + (upper_price - lower_price) * (requested_days - lower_days) / (upper_days - lower_days)). Use the nearest lower and upper points of the SAME complete plan key. Round only the final result, with half a cent rounded up. This is a total package price, not a daily rate. Country fixed packages list each offer on a separate line under its exact duration.
Country fixed groups use unique keys COUNTRY CODE+SIZE+DAYS+d, for example US5GB25d. Search that complete key to read the group from its beginning. Every line after it is Variant=total USD for that exact country, size and duration, until the next group key or heading. Each line gives the price of only that variant. Compare all lines under the requested duration, including ties. Each country has one Fixed Buy template immediately below its country heading. Use that template for its fixed packages: set {g} to the data= value directly below the requested size heading (or the row's own data= value), set {d} to the chosen duration, and set {r} from the variant colour: Blue=blue, Black=black, Pink=pink, Green=green, Yellow=yellow, AmberEssential=amber. For Black2, use route=black. The variant number is never part of the URL. For conditions, search the country name and bare variant ID together, for example Japan Yellow1; omit data=, pick= and p= suffixes. Variant numbers identify the country-specific conditions table. Networks and internet exit belong to that variant only. 'See product page' supplies no network name.
A row marked pick=2 or higher is another option of the same colour. Append &plan= followed by that row's complete p= key, including rp_, to select it directly. Copy only the key after p=, not the pick number. The key applies only to that offer under its duration heading.
Each unlimited plan has a unique key repeated at the start of each of its price rows. Its conditions and Buy template are immediately below its heading. The price rows contain at most 20 explicit days=USD points each. Match the complete key, including the country code, before selecting points. The directories give a destination code and plan suffixes; join them without spaces. Set {d} in that plan's Buy template to the chosen duration.
Purple fully unlimited plans have no daily quota. Other unlimited plans give a daily high-speed allowance that resets each day, followed by unlimited data at the stated speed. Country fixed variants are full-speed data with hotspot except Amber Essential, which has a 1 Mbps speed cap and no hotspot.
Each country fixed-size block lists regional lookup templates beside data=. Replace {d} with the chosen number of days and compare those rows too, unless the request explicitly says country-only. A cheapest eSIM for one country may be a regional package. Unless country-only is explicitly requested, compare country packages AND regional offers covering that country. Each country lists Regional keys for regions containing at least one offer covering that country. These keys are navigation, not a guarantee that every offer covers it. To compare a country offer with regional alternatives, search each regional key + size + duration + d followed by the word offers to find the beginning of the complete group, then check the chosen variant coverage. For regional fixed packages, first use the Regional fixed coverage by country directory to select eligible variants. Each package-duration heading lists all offers on separate rows, ordered by total USD price. Form its lookup key by joining the region code, the data allowance and the number of days followed by d. The heading states the group minimum before any coverage filtering; a minimum is eligible only if its row covers every required country. Read every row under that heading, including ties. Each regional offer row contains Variant|USD total|plan|Complete coverage, optionally followed by calls/SMS. If the group has multiple offers, each row additionally starts with the complete package key. A single offer belongs to the unique offers heading immediately above it. Its own coverage list is the eligibility check: every required country must occur in that same row. Read all rows under the requested size and duration, including ties. Copy the complete plan key from the same row as the selected variant and price into {p} in the Buy template above, set {d} to the requested duration, and replace data= only when that offer has its own data= value. For the complete coverage and networks of a variant, search its region name followed by the bare variant ID in the region's Variant conditions table. Choose only variants covering every required country. A region's name does not guarantee coverage. Regional unlimited blocks contain their own coverage and prices. Coverage uses the country codes or names supplied with each offer. For coverage matching, AN counts as Curaçao (CW).
Special-package rows state their category explicitly: Inflight and Cruise are different products. WorldPass rows state both initial payment and renewal; phone-number prices cover the whole stated term. Include the selected offer's completed purchase link in recommendations.

## Country unlimited-plan directory

Each line gives COUNTRY (CODE) followed by plan suffixes. Join CODE + suffix without spaces to obtain the heading key. daily3GB1Mbps means 3GB of high-speed data resetting each day, then unlimited data at 1 Mbps. unlimited1Mbps means no daily quota, at up to 1 Mbps. Other sizes and speeds follow the same notation; full terms are in each plan block.

## WorldPass data and coverage
Every WorldPass term includes one shared USD 30.00 monthly Fast Data Wallet across the supported countries and networks. The GB amounts below show how far that same wallet goes if used on the listed network; they are not separate allowances to add together. Unused wallet rolls over for up to 3 months.
After the fast-data wallet is exhausted, slower unlimited data is available only on networks marked yes. Networks marked no need a top-up after fast data is exhausted.
